insight: Peacock blue, aquamarine, liquid glass. Never Cinzel. Never torch-and-scroll fantasy UI. The aesthetic target is Azuki meets Claude.ai — magical intelligence, not childish fantasy.
Never rename things to generic labels to make them 'more accessible.' Deepen the character like a Skyrim NPC instead. 'Mentor Agent' is forgettable; Aiyami is not.
Show, don't tell. The product IS the demo. If your landing page has to explain what the thing does with stock illustrations, the thing isn't ready — ship the thing you're showing.
Typography trinity: Space Grotesk for display, Inter for body, JetBrains Mono for code. Three fonts, one voice. Adding a fourth is a tell that you don't trust any of them.
